sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US IRA-driven domestic manufacturing credits and grid interconnection reforms are structurally re-rating US solar module and inverter makers, favoring ENPH/SEDG/FSLR over Chinese peers.
Energy storage and hybrid thermal-renewable platforms (NRG, VST) are capturing higher capacity payments and ancillary revenue, creating durable earnings diversification beyond pure generation.
Global supply-chain diversification, especially Korean module exports (051910) to the US, is accelerating as tariff walls and local-content requirements lock in premium pricing.
sectors.ai: Buy selective US solar/energy-storage names (ENPH, SEDG, FSLR) and Korean module maker 051910 on the WATCH signal; PLUG's spike is speculative, trim into strength. NRG/VST confirm thermal+renewable hybrid resilience. Add on any 3-5% pullback, target 12-15% upside over 8 weeks, hedge with short ARRY.

Focus on AGAR, DOSS, CMG for momentum continuation, but rotate into ESTI and PCAR for value. Trim WMPP and NAYZ on overextension. Maintain overweight staples, underweight discretionary until rupiah stabilizes.
